area: Keystone testbed: capture routes as reproducible proof artefacts

find.report_claim: keystone.evidence provides named Route/Checkpoint plans, capture_route, write_evidence and diff_evidence so before/after proof is a hashable artefact rather than a pair of ad-hoc filenames; the shooter had never imported it
find.live_evidence: scripts/capture.py writes dozens of before/after PNG+report pairs by hand with bespoke route functions; no route summary or machine-readable diff existed
find.consumer_evidence: capture_route only needs run(), capture() and scene, which the real headless Engine satisfies, so an isolated driver can own the evidence contract without changing the game
